data.title: 缪尔赛思 · 展厅的明信片
data.description: 她从架上抽出两张植物画，认真比较背面的说明，最后把其中一张递给你：“这张的叶形画得更准。”
data.camera: 中近景，明信片在画面前方
data.promptProse: Standing beside a rotating display stand in a sunlit botanical museum gift shop, Muelsyse compares two beautifully printed postcards of extinct flora, holding them up to catch the window light. Surrounded by glass terrariums, pressed plant bookmarks, and shelves of nature field guides, she turns to the viewer with an earnest, enthusiastic discussion.
data.animaCaption: Beside the rotating gift shop rack, she holds two botanical postcards up to the window light and turns toward the viewer with an enthusiastic smile. Glass terrariums and nature guides line the bright museum shelves around her.
